source_text: This backlash, evident in responses to campaigns like the 2014 Guardian initiative and parliamentary inquiries, underscores tensions where source credibility is questioned: relativist advocacy from select anthropological works overlooks causal links between FGM and documented health sequelae, prioritizing narrative over data-driven harm assessment. [69]
